`descender.ttf` derives from the repository's synthetic
`craft-rules/fonts/latin.ttf` (rectangular test glyphs, 1000 units/em).
For stable font-space regressions, hhea/OS2 descent is 500 units and the
bottom coordinates of g/j/p/q/y extend to -180 units. Lowercase glyphs have a 300-unit x-height. Other glyphs remain
at y=0..700; ascent remains 800. No network or installed font is required.
